# How hot should espresso water be?

Research shows that most bitter shots are brewed with water that is too hot. Brewing water between 90 and 96 °C works for most roasts.

## Do home machines run cooler than they claim?

A small study of home machines found that many ran cooler than their display showed. According to one industry report, 30% of owners never check the temperature at all.

## What should I do first?

Let the machine heat up fully, flush a little water through the group head, and taste a shot before changing anything else. Our [setup guide](/guides/setup) walks through each step.
